payload.reason: The evidence provides multiple claims regarding the effectiveness of the NCEL approach, demonstrating its superior performance across various datasets and comparisons with baseline methods.

claims.text: NCEL outperforms all baseline methods in both easy and hard cases, demonstrating its effectiveness in entity linking tasks.
NCEL consistently outperforms various baselines with favorable generalization ability across five different datasets.
The proposed method achieves the best performance in most cases with an average gain of 2% on Micro F1 and 3% Macro F1 compared to global models.
